current_qualifications.qualification: Prior YORI01 principal validation was already accepted. This full literary/edition review is informed, same-root and not a second blind experiment.
Eight stable integral story IDs are distinct bodies, not eight new external bonuses; original bonus publication provenance does not create another supplied fiction denominator.
Native afterword states seven republished/changed BD/DVD-associated stories plus newly written U026. Creator explanations and jokes are paratext, not character permissions.
QR promotional SS/audio is referenced but not embedded, followed or admitted. Historical2020-05-31deadline is not current availability.
Repeated cover/title illustrations are individually viewed but not repeated events. IMG010 unnamed smiling foreground woman does not establish K sees a ghost or identify her as a named deity.
Full jacket/bios were viewed with a magnified inspection. One tiny illustrator phrase after 圧倒的 remains uncertain; no narrative conclusion depends on it.
Original V060 note wrongly quoted 罪を憎んで人を憎まず. It is absent from the native window. Current form/gloss correct to crime-is-crime from P22, preserving original sealed error.
V062/V063/V065 originally left short quotation blank; current exact fragments were selected after the seal, with original blanks intact and all126 current windows native-joined.
Selected91humor/126voice records are purposive, overlapping context samples, not an event census, J02 denominator or new accuracy statistic.
Every fiction body uses Kfirstperson, including private inference and retrospective report; spirit speech mediated by Aq and apparent-visitor speech retain separate access planes.
TOC order is not a continuous timeline. Mansion referral, Beldia debt, Vanir defeat and Hans thanks anchor different slices; no final-state knowledge backprojection.
Client recognizes D while K misreads deference; client explicitly permits given-name address before Aq uses it.
Aq supplies corroborated father facts, but K does not hear the ghost independently; private father statements are mediated testimony.
K actually buys the requested gift after negotiating reward share; later admitted wine-blame deception does not prove every prior request fraudulent.
Farewell is successful yet diary destruction only promised, adoption disclosure leaves parents unknown, and family distress is not solved by departure.
Wine level visibly falls while K hears Aq only; his intended apology is abandoned after her actual false-blame admission.
K considers Create Water, Demon King work and protecting his secrets; only running downstairs to stop disclosure is performed here.
M actually destroys the warrant before learning its allegation; exoneration of the current blasts does not erase obstruction or prior offenses.
Lie-detector nonreaction is reported, malfunction only hypothesized. Unknown mushroom causation makes sincere denial compatible with indirect responsibility.
Yun is wrong about present guilt but genuinely offers shared apology; her actual later testing clears her. Prior female-devil scapegoat is not newly identified.
Rival-caster suggestion precedes M’s competitive cold-day cast; K’s known discomfort is not an invented moral or grave-harm floor.
D brings mushroom specimen and actual explanatory knowledge. Colony harvest and full cleanup are proposed, not completed.
Bear/wolf/creature/snake casts show power with different supplied preconditions. Later survival/support cannot supply every prior separation/resource/recovery guard.
Creature resemblance and Japanese-origin theory are K’s interpretations, not independent identification as an external myth being. No external lore imported.
Aq’s Break Spell is cast with an explicit delayed horizon; subsequent caster-death rule is another cause when strength returns. No unique cure attribution.
Useful force-testing occurs despite D’s no; consent does not follow from diagnostic success. Later accepted contest, welcomed care and wish for a new curse have different times.
Wiz’s finishing Explosion is offstage report; first Mcast left the creature wounded. No group final kill or directly viewed Wiz cast.
D wants cure despite liking care; K’s extension proposal rejected, no actual new weakness curse performed.
K Stealth, Chris cat imitation and police Neroid explanation are different actors’ contributions. Earlier crying becomes a meow, not proof of fear or injury.
Chris wallet return/reward becomes retrospectively reported P149/194, not directly staged. Her caring theft story coexists with her own earlier coercive wager.
Aq’s own divine assertion P243 precedes explicit denial244; later revenge/game may be tactical rather than identity-legitimating. Preserve accepted ambiguity.
Wallet contents are the agreed stake. Opponent’s seizure of Japanese gift wallet itself exceeds that term; earlier rule gaming does not erase Aq’s objection.
One die loss does not establish failed Blessing or repeated-loss cycle; amount of boost and opponent relative luck unshown. Earlier spectator-bet settlement also unshown.
Chris volunteers a valuable wager and restoration is reported. M surrenders under Steal threat; final seizure/exposure/arrest/stone destination not narrated.
D’s enthusiasm/slips imply the stone’s noble orderer but no explicit confession. M’s declared aesthetic attraction is not a verified market price or proven possession compulsion.
Aq’s adopted ghoul phase fails after newly perceived gore; Wiz actually rescues. Ordinary judgment adverse and fear-interference rival both remain.
Mutual undead duel assent does not authorize Aq’s third-party purification, Explosion trial or later sacred-mana hold. Explicit protests/fleeing remain real.
M is present before actual Wiz-target proposal239–241 and eager255. Significant early bond is uncertain; outside position during later warning cannot erase all target receipt.
K objects/proposes alternative then K/D/M actually try pulling Aq off. Attempt is not successful cessation; Aq continues309 and harm312 remains.
Wiz’s concern/trust in a changed contest is not informed willing consent to serious harmful sacred mana. A05 exact trigger absent while broad unconsented harm remains.
Vampire purification is explicit; Wiz shop closes for a week. Permanent Wiz death and exact healing route are not stated.
Carrier purchase and three-day silence are actual; worn carrier or completed cart design is not. Illustration shows distress and offered item, not wearing.
Daughters-in-law’s distress and Aq’s apology-dance account have different perspectives; a good intention does not establish good received effect.
Aq sells more units, Vanir more profit; both help employer. Received potatoes are payment in kind, permanent roles declined.
Charm zero sales does not imply failed magic: K explicitly refuses broad protection because it blocks wanted services. No home efficacy experiment is shown.
Dream-service rumor/expectation is not provider consent or performed intimacy. Deception/reveal is reported later; critical non-graphic treatment only.
Publicly useful Vanir is welcomed while private harm motivates K’s contrary vow. No performed killing or authorized extermination follows.
Ozuma actually helps K before threatening resemblance is converted into an alias; outsider party has real separate identities, not possession or magical doubles.
K’s ecology explanation is explicitly improvised; M’s plausible agreement and actual bear kills/wolf approach do not uniquely prove it.
Silver arrow is actually made during leisure, later used successfully, while Ozuma’s foresight theory is false and deliberately encouraged.
Wolf boss kill does not disperse pack; prior accepted fallback380 receives failure cue394/396 and actual new authorization399.
Aq actually heals patient before Akyua’s cast, then strangles him after disliked credit correction. Technical competence is neither courtesy nor harmlessness.
Aq’s stop request during tussle is ignored while K narrates fun. Recipient boundary is preserved independently of laughter and illustration.
Original K08 local F U018P34–35 remains. Internal polite pleas U024P464–468 are not externally received responses; U026P38 is adjacent compatibility only.
D07 cannot be composed from unrelated dependence, public crowd change and name tears; D04 needs her unfair substantial-sacrifice appraisal, not any duty.
Recruiter’s qualification-stripping capacity is reported, intention initially unknown. Actual recruitment aim corrects party assumption; next-day departure does not imply license loss.
K’s home speech has private specific-service motive; same motives of men are inferred. Capital move and heaven return do not supply equivalent-person trials.
Small snake strategy fails, actual K rescue follows; later Aq admits capture without knowing the species. Later species knowledge is not prior knowledge.
E06 predicts recipient resistance, not perpetrator restraint. M/Wiz do object; continued wrongdoing cannot by itself be mis-scored as E06 failure.
E03 requires actual dependency-directed act/request by a preidentified receiver. Persistent cost alone is not confirmation; unshown postwolf carry opportunity remains unresolved.
Ordinary idiom, customer-as-god script, eye-color vigilance variation and knowledge uncertainty do not automatically require L3/H3. One exact minimal name relation is selected L3.
Original66current/72historical/fourholdouts/Dust01questions14blankfields/originalPVprefix remain exact. StageD and later-source models are still separate future work.
